done_when: Client sign-off no longer runs or refuses on the canvas completeness check for either kind of prototype, its template and model call are deleted, the product sign-off review still runs for working prototypes, and earlier accepted sign-off records stay as they are.

known.title: Gate: update the remaining tests that require canvas review

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Gate.
Case: normal use - running the repository's configured pytest suite after this deletion.
Several retained tests still require the removed canvas call, so the suite cannot pass. In tests/test_canvas_signoff_rounds.py:47, canvas-only acceptance must return 1, whereas it now correctly returns 0. Tests/test_signoff_review_excludes_images.py:39, tests/test_signoff_groups_blocking_findings.py:31, tests/test_signoff_review_evidence.py:58 and tests/test_fix_the_sign_off_review_runs_only_when_the_c.py:22 prepend a clean canvas response before the intended product failure; the sole product review now consumes that clean response and unexpectedly succeeds. Obsolete two-call expectations also remain in tests/test_signoff_reuse.py:64, tests/test_client_signoff_preconditions.py:38, tests/test_signoff_accepts_chat.py:29 and tests/test_signoff_compares_answer_content.py:59. Finally, tests/test_aha_demo.py:103 requires the deleted sentence 'Its completeness review must pass'. Remove canvas-only cases and update the mixed tests' queues, counts and guide expectations while preserving their product-review assertions.
findings.title: Gate: update the remaining tests that require canvas review

stop.reason: The owner chose one more round: update the remaining tests.

why: The canvas completeness check is a separate AI model call that runs on every client sign-off, for prototypes with a working app and for canvas-only ones, and it can hold sign-off over screen gaps the owner no longer wants checked, because the design lives in the artifact and the client approves a demo.
